audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Heimerdinger though whys[0] says neither side can commit; levels 4-5 and first item were 'Skill' though whys[3] says you cannot even reach a target and whys[5] says your dive dies in the turret zone; 2+ items was Heimerdinger though whys[6] says your reset chain beats his turret leash.
audit.why: H-28 G Evolution Turret is a 1-second cooldown deployable and Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units, so he holds every stage until Irelia's second item lets her cross the zone and stick.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 set to Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Irelia in both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings — the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike and mid gave no numbers, and the two-item spike credited the flip to a passive armour/MR shred Irelia does not have.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank with 970 range — a fixed number the player can count. Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed on spell hits and adds bonus on-hit at max stacks; it shreds nothing.
audit.corrected: The grenade's flat 11s and 970 range written into the level-6 spike, mid and Key Ability Interactions; the two-item spike and late now credit four-stack Ionian Fervor on-hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors run through the page. (1) Every mention of his E calls it 'CH-3X grenade'; the real name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. (2) spikes[2], mid, late and wants.you[0] all tell you to hold Defiant Dance to soak the grenade or the turret burst — Riot's text says Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage while charging, and Heimerdinger's turrets, rockets, grenade and UPGRADE!!! are all magic damage, so it absorbs none of it. Holding a charge into a 970-range stun is the worst possible instruction.
audit.why: The packet already flags that the page never names a single Heimerdinger ability correctly. The Defiant Dance premise turns a survivable poke lane into a lost one, because the player stands still charging a spell that does nothing while the grenade lands.
audit.corrected: Real ability name used in whys[4], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[2]; the Defiant Dance-as-answer premise replaced with sidestepping and with counting the flat 11s grenade cooldown.

edits.before: CH-3X grenade is a long-range stun that cancels your entire engage, so his level 6 hard-counters your Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge dive onto the turrets.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is an 11s, 970-range stun that cancels your engage, so his level 6 hard-counters your Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge dive.

edits.before: His CH-3X grenade (E) is a long-range stun that hard-counters your engage — hold Defiant Dance to eat it or the turret burst, because if the grenade lands your E-into-R all-in dies on top of his turrets.
edits.after: His CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) is a flat 11s, 970-range stun that hard-counters your engage — Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only, so it saves you from none of his kit when the grenade lands.

edits.before: This is his strongest stretch and you have to respect it. At 6 his CH-3X grenade is a long-range stun that hard-counters your whole engage — if it lands, both your Flawless Duet stun combo and your Vanguard's Edge dive die on his turrets. Your one tool is the channel: hold Defiant Dance to soak the grenade or tank the turret burst, then Flawless Duet stun and Q-reset in. Only all-in when his grenade is on cooldown and his turrets aren't freshly stacked, otherwise you just hand him the wave and the zone.
edits.after: This is his strongest stretch and you have to respect it. At 6 his CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a 970-range stun that hard-counters your whole engage — if it lands, both your Flawless Duet combo and your Vanguard's Edge dive die on his turrets. Don't plan around Defiant Dance: it cuts physical damage only, and his turrets, rockets and grenade are all magic. The grenade is a flat 11s at every rank, so count it, all-in inside that gap, and never step up while his turrets are freshly stacked.

edits.before: Now it flips to you. With Trinity Force plus a second item your reset chain finally out-ranges his turret leash — Q onto a turret, dash through it to him, and his short H-28G blink has no answer while your passive shreds his armor and MR and you stick like glue. Wall his escape and his turret retreat with Vanguard's Edge, hold Defiant Dance for the grenade, and you win the duel outright. In fights you flank past the turrets entirely and chain Bladesurge resets into his backline — but close on objectives before his upgraded turrets turn a siege into a fortress.
edits.after: Now it flips to you. With Trinity Force plus a second item your reset chain finally out-ranges his turret leash — Q onto a minion, dash through to him, and Ionian Fervor's stacking attack speed and four-stack on-hit kill him before he walks out of it. Wall his escape and his turret retreat with Vanguard's Edge, and save your stun for the moment the grenade is spent, and you win the duel outright. In fights you flank past the turrets entirely and chain Bladesurge resets into his backline — but close on objectives before his upgraded turrets turn a siege into a fortress.

edits.before: With Trinity Force plus a second item your Q-reset chain finally out-paces his turret leash — reset off a turret, Q through to him, and your passive armor/MR shred kills him before his short H-28G blink saves him.
edits.after: With Trinity Force plus a second item your Q-reset chain finally out-paces his turret leash — reset off a minion, Q through to him, and your four-stack Ionian Fervor on-hit kills him before he can walk out.

edits.before: Save Defiant Dance for his CH-3X grenade so the stun whiffs and your Flawless Duet stun lands clean for the follow-up
edits.after: Sidestep his CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — Defiant Dance cuts physical only and will not save you from the stun

edits.before: Land CH-3X grenade to cancel your dash chain and re-stack turrets on top of the stunned target
edits.after: Land CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade to cancel your dash chain and re-stack turrets on the stunned target

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — E-stun + Q him.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank and 970 range — commit only inside that gap.

notes: wants.you[1] tells the player to use Heimerdinger's own turrets as Bladesurge reset targets. Bladesurge's reset condition in Riot's text is a Marked target or a target that dies to it, and nothing in the kits says whether it can target or reset off a deployed turret. I could not verify it, so I left the line untouched rather than delete a possibly-real tech. Also note the full layer's diff reads EVEN while diffRating is 8.5/10 and report[14] says 'Hard matchup' — the EVEN token disagrees with both.
